$comment: Bounty-owned configuration for the Shoal swarm-testing layer. Shoal itself is NOT configured by a file (its CLI takes flags only) — this file is read by qa/shoal/bin/*.mjs, which translates it into real Shoal CLI flags. Do not put secrets here.

shoal.$commitNote: Pinned. Shoal is not published to npm and has no tags; a moving HEAD would silently change agent behaviour between runs. Bump deliberately, then re-run `npm run qa:shoal:setup`.

local.label: Local Expo web (metro dev server)
local.$note: `npm run web:pw` / `APP_ENV=staging npx expo start --web --port 8090`. Points at the STAGING Supabase project, not production.

staging.label: Staging Supabase project via local web build
staging.$note: Bounty has no hosted staging web deployment (the product ships as an Expo native app; the web target exists for Playwright). Until one exists, `staging` and `local` target the same locally-served bundle wired to the staging backend.

guards.$allowedRefsNote: staging + development refs from lib/config/supabase-refs.json. The production ref is deliberately absent.
